subject: MAP: Eval deliverables, TTFT & artifact bundle for close

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Eval deliverables, TTFT & artifact bundle for close

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the time today — good alignment on the evaluation goals. Per our MAP I promised to capture the concrete deliverables we will provide for your internal sign-off and procurement:

• Performance benchmark artifacts (CSV exports of raw runs)
• Executive readout slides summarizing TTFT, p50/p95 latencies, throughput curves, and concurrency behavior
• A live dashboard link into a read-only Redwood Console view for the eval window
• A short runbook describing how we measured (input prompts, batch sizes, quantization, warm/cold)

Request: can you confirm target concurrency(s) to prioritize? We planned 1, 8, and 64 as the MAP states, but if you want an additional 16/32 we can add that. Also confirm target close date so we align the readout timing — you mentioned "end of May" as a goal.

I'll loop in engineering to produce the artifact bundle (CSV + slides + dashboard snapshot). Expect a first pass by next Thursday (5/13).

Warmly,
Jordan Blake

Jordan —

Thanks, that list looks great. Confirm MAP priorities: 1, 8, 64 are exactly what our infra team cares about. Please include:

• Cold-start TTFT (first-token time) and a note on whether that includes model download/initialization.
• p50 and p95 generation latency at the three concurrency points.
• Sustained throughput (tokens/sec) for a 30-minute run.

We are targeting a procurement decision by 2027-05-24. If you can deliver artifacts + a 20-min exec readout the week of 5/17, we should be able to close.

Also, can you provide CSV exports that map run id → concurrency → sequence length → latency metrics? Our SRE will ingest those into our tooling.

Thanks — Sam

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Eval deliverables, TTFT & artifact bundle for close

Marissa / Ben —

Looping you both in to run the MAP-measured artifacts Sam requested. TL;DR / asks:

1) Test matrix: concurrency = [1, 8, 64]; sequence lengths = [64, 256, 1024]; 30-minute sustained runs where applicable.
2) Metrics: cold TTFT, median and p95 per-token latency, sustained throughput (tokens/sec), failure/error counts.
3) Output: CSV with columns (run_id, concurrency, seq_len, sample_id, p50_ms, p95_ms, ttft_ms, tokens_per_sec), a small README describing measurement methodology, and a 6-slide executive summary with a one-slide recommendation.
4) Packaging: ZIP the CSVs + README + slides. Name convention: finlytics_MAP_v1.zip.

Timeline: Sam wants artifacts + readout week of 5/17. Can you target first-run artifacts by EOD 5/13 so we have time for a short internal review? If you hit blockers (GPU availability, model variant differences), escalate to me.

Ben — please run the 64-concurrency sustained test on the dedicated pool (quantized model) and include resource utilization (GPU % and memory). Marissa — can you assemble slides and do the CSV formatting + README?

Thanks — this is a tight MAP but should be straightforward.

Jordan

Quick status and first-pass numbers — delivering CSVs and slides attached. Summary below (full CSVs in attachment):

Summary (median / p95 / TTFT cold):
• Concurrency 1 (seq=256): p50 = 86 ms, p95 = 176 ms, TTFT (cold) = 1,420 ms
• Concurrency 8 (seq=256): p50 = 108 ms, p95 = 240 ms, TTFT (cold) = 1,425 ms
• Concurrency 64 (seq=256): p50 = 380 ms, p95 = 720 ms, TTFT (cold) = 1,430 ms

Throughput (tokens/sec sustained, quantized model):
• Concurrency 1: 750 tokens/sec
• Concurrency 8: 5,200 tokens/sec
• Concurrency 64: 36,000 tokens/sec (note: measured across a 30-min continuous run; saw occasional GC/reload spikes at min 18 and 44)

Notes:
• TTFT here measures first-token generation time after cold start of runtime process; model files were pre-warmed for dedicated pool tests, but cold-run includes the initial model load (we flagged the CSV rows with "cold_run" boolean).
• We recorded GPU utilization traces; 64-concurrency sustained runs averaged 88% GPU utilization on the dedicated pool.
• CSV formatting follows Sam's requested schema (run_id, concurrency, seq_len, sample_id, p50_ms, p95_ms, ttft_ms, tokens_per_sec).

Attachments included: finlytics_TTFT_summary.csv (CSV), MAP_artifacts_v1.zip (contains raw CSVs + README + perf traces), readout_slides_FinLytics_v1.pdf

If these numbers look good, I can produce a shorter one-page exec note for the readout. Ben — anything to add on anomalies from the 30-min logs?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Performance Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Final: FinLytics MAP artifact bundle + exec readout scheduling

Samantha —

Thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the artifact bundle we discussed and a short executive summary slide deck. Highlights for your exec team:

• Cold TTFT: ~1.42s (includes initial model load for cold runs)
• p50/p95 (seq=256): 108ms / 240ms at concurrency=8 — well within your SLO target of sub-300ms p95 for interactive flows
• Sustained throughput (quantized): 36k tokens/sec at concurrency=64; GPU utilization ~88% during sustained window

Artifacts attached: finlytics_TTFT_summary.csv, MAP_artifacts_v1.zip (raw CSVs + README + perf traces), readout_slides_FinLytics_v1.pdf

Live dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/finlytics-eval-2027 (read-only view; expires 2027-05-31).

Proposed readout: 20 minutes + 10 minutes Q&A. I’m available Tue 5/18 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 5/19 14:00–15:00 PT. Our recommendation (one-slide in the deck) is to proceed with Dedicated pool for production and enable prefix caching for your high-frequency prompts to reduce p95 under 200ms.

Can we lock the procurement decision on 2027-05-24 per the MAP? If so I’ll coordinate procurement contacts and draft the SOW.
